name: agentviva
description: Check whether an AI tool, agent or API is still alive, and set up monitoring that says so.

api_key.title: AgentViva API key
api_key.description: Optional. Your team key (av_live_...), made on the API page at https://agentviva.dev/app/api and shown only once. Without it you can still look up tools AgentViva already watches; with it you get all the tools. Change it later: /plugin, Installed tab, AgentViva, Configure options, then restart Claude Code.
